summary: Iteration 3 final production-readiness regression: 16/16 backend hardening pytest cases PASS and 7/7 frontend smoke flows PASS including the previously-reported 3D click-crash scenario. All review_request items verified end-to-end. The 3D hero click-crash bug is gone — canvas absorbed 10 clicks across different positions, stayed mounted, page title preserved, zero alpha/three/webgl/pageerror console entries. Pydantic v2 validation error renders cleanly in UI as 'message: String should have at least 5 characters' (no raw object leak). ALLOWED_ORIGINS correctly includes preview URL so browser tests work against ingress. robots.txt served (with Cloudflare-prepended bot policy; our User-agent:* + Sitemap: present). sitemap.xml returns valid XML with 11 pivotsafe.com URLs incl. homepage. Home <title> / og:title / twitter:card present. /docs /redoc /openapi.json all 404. Admin bearer auth: 401 without/wrong, 200 with correct ADMIN_TOKEN from /app/backend/.env. Honeypot returns id=honeypot, does NOT persist a lead, does NOT burn rate-limit slot (6x honeypot + 1 legit submit from same IP = 201, not 429). Rate limit: 3 valid from fresh IP 203.0.113.77 succeed, 4th returns 429. CORS allowlist verified against localhost:8001 (preview ingress masks headers publicly — known infra limitation, not a code bug). Resend is live and emails actually fired.

minor.issue: Preview ingress (Cloudflare) overrides CORS headers to '*' regardless of Origin. Backend itself enforces the allowlist correctly — verified directly against http://localhost:8001. Not a regression; production at pivotsafe.com will behave as designed.

Cloudflare prepends its own managed bot-policy block + duplicate 'User-agent: *' in front of our static /app/frontend/public/robots.txt content. Our required User-agent:* and Sitemap: lines ARE present at the end of the response, so requirements pass. Acceptable CF-managed behavior.
Still an in-process per-IP deque — single-process only. Not a regression; documented in iter1/iter2 action items.

issues: Brand logo lockup flush top-left confirmed, breadcrumbs styled, readable contrast, no layout issues visible.

action_items: No blockers for production release. Carry-over nice-to-haves from iter1/iter2: (1) migrate rate-limiter from in-process deque to Redis/Mongo for multi-worker deployments, (2) verify CORS headers under the production pivotsafe.com domain (preview ingress masks them), (3) ensure deploy pipeline wipes /app/frontend/.next before next dev/next start to prevent the stale-prerender-cache regression documented in iter2, (4) consider resolving the pre-existing iter1 nested-button hydration warning in hero.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains clean and production-grade: fail-closed admin dep (404 when ADMIN_TOKEN unset, 401 on missing/bad bearer), docs/redoc/openapi disabled, indexes idempotent, honeypot rollback verified, persistence+email failures handled independently, 503 only fires when BOTH fail, HTML-escaped email template.

contactWidget.tsx extractErrorMessage correctly handles Pydantic v2 detail arrays — UI rendered 'message: String should have at least 5 characters' (string, not object). No more [object Object] render crash.

otherShapeThree.tsx — confirmed NO onClick handler anywhere; canvas clicks do not dispatch any React state update, which was the root cause of the previous crash loop. gl config has alpha/antialias/powerPreference set. SceneErrorBoundary wraps the scene and would render data-testid=scene-error-fallback if anything threw — it did not trigger (fallback_count=0 after 10 clicks).
floating-navbar.tsx flush-left spacing (px-6 sm:px-10 lg:px-16) renders correctly; brand logo appears top-left on homepage and inner pages.
sitemap.ts emits 11 valid <url> entries including https://pivotsafe.com/ homepage with weekly changefreq priority 1.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded from admin endpoint response via projection {"_id": 0}.
